acceptance: Minimal smoke contracts and pinning/toolchain choices are executable; scalar semantics remain values-owned, catalogs/declarations producer-owned. Feeds C03.2 vectors + pins.json and C03.complete negative evidence per selected profile.
corruption_rules: Bad transport/profile versions and bad declared lengths are rejected before any semantic work; unknown versions never fall through to a default profile.
Truncated, oversized, and short frames fail deterministically with a transport error, never a semantic result; EOF/abort mid-request releases the call allocation.
Fixed-width counts/ranges are validated before conversion; overflow rejects before coercion (never coerce-then-check).
Token-once validation: mismatched, replayed, or cross-call tokens fail; cancellation fails deterministically at the current stage.
Serde/metadata renderers are never the compatibility authority: serde JSON errors do not substitute for host syntax diagnostics, and generic serializer output is not parity evidence.

envelopes.error_envelope: Ordered tagged error with profile, machine-readable code, ordered reasons/details, and failure stage. Transport errors (version/length/corruption/lifetime) are distinguishable from semantic errors (validation/policy refusal); a started native failure never falls through to TS.
envelopes.result_envelope: Ordered tagged result carrying the profile id, request token, presence-explicit payload refs/values, and completion stage. Preview/confirmed and prepared/failed states are explicit; no per-leaf IPC or semantic TS retry inside one call.

lifetime_rules: Call-local opaque references: indices/handles are valid only within their originating call/session; stale, foreign, and cross-call indices are rejected.
Dispose/release on every exit path: success, exception, cancellation, and rejected load; release is idempotent.
Bounded allocation: arenas, plan caches, and handle tables have explicit caps; no caller-controlled unbounded type-string or metadata cache.
Rust/native sides cannot inspect untouched payloads or metadata; materialization happens only at the profile's declared point with the profile's declared clone/retain rule.
Clone failures, disposal failures, and limit breaches preserve the original failure (no silent substitution); structuredClone points stay at the existing profile location.

ownership.catalogs_declarations_producer_owned: Currency/type/operation catalogs, schema declarations, target/runtime/compiler facts, and release manifests are derived from or verified against current package producers. No independent copied catalogs; drift/version tests guard producer changes.
ownership.no_universal_codec: No generic universal serializer/validator. Values, work-fact, and native-session payloads keep separately owned codecs; shared mechanisms are reused, invented universal policies are not.
ownership.scalar_semantics_values_owned: f64 bits, BigInt operands, decimal/money/temporal scalar meaning, and numeric-string distinctions are defined by packages/values. Consumers transport scalars; they do not redefine them.

per_plan_bindings.artifact_preparation: P03.3 implements Begin/NeedHost/ResumeHost/Prepared/Failed over byte frames under this contract; protocol stdout stays clean; state and module buffers persist in one retained process per job.
per_plan_bindings.exact_values: A07.1/A07.2 build the tiny real binding + host carriers/bootstrap checks; A07.3 joins full semantic entries through the real adapter. No mocked loader counts as Worker success.
per_plan_bindings.input_validation: V03.1 defines the validation ABI extension + decision vectors; V03.2 builds the ordered input transport arena; V03.3 mints the private parser token with controlled lineage; V03.4 implements owner registration/generation handles; V03.5 lands the coordinated minimal binding.
per_plan_bindings.work_transitions: W03.1 freezes ordered facts + policy-specific ABI types with producer provenance; W03.2 implements call-local opaque reference lifecycle; W03.3/W03.4 extract demand-ordered host shells and verify closed-fact provenance against prepared-vs-legacy traces.

planning_status: proposed; method contract only; no implementation authorized by this record

presence.profiles: Presence is profile-owned, not universal: values accumulation vs interfaces own-presence vs state ref-version domains keep their own accepted presence rules. The transport carries explicit presence tags; each profile interprets them per its frozen rule.
presence.rule: Presence is explicit on the wire: missing, own-null, own-undefined, inherited, and accessor-backed positions are distinct tags. Absent-vs-undefined conflation is forbidden at the transport layer.

profile_handoffs.native_session: Retained-session payloads (artifact indexes, module buffers, plan buffers/digests) persist per job under the framed protocol; host stages resume with tokens; prior-plan reads stay demand-driven.
profile_handoffs.values_payloads: Exact scalars, structured values, schema plans, and validation verdicts cross as ordered tagged nodes with explicit presence; arbitrary host-object/iterator paths stay TS until proved.
profile_handoffs.work_facts: Closed ordered fact batches with producer provenance; opaque payload refs are data refs, never authority capabilities (no load/query/invoke/commit capability enters facts).

scalars.bigint: Raw BigInt operands cross losslessly (arbitrary width); no narrowing to fixed width without a versioned behavior decision + migration fixtures.
scalars.f64: IEEE-754 bits preserved exactly, including -0, nonfinite values, huge rounded JSON integers, and 1e400-style overflow spellings. Host parser numeric outcomes (including nonfinite and -0) remain representable and reach the profile's rejection stage; they are never pre-collapsed by the transport.
scalars.numeric_strings: Numeric-looking strings/keys are text, never numbers; numeric-looking key order and duplicate JSON keys are preserved exactly as data.

scope_source: shared scope.json (C01.1, accepted) + prepared-baseline-contract.json (C02.1, accepted): port-scope packages byte-identical checkpoint-to-head; transport applies at current main

smoke_and_pinning_scope.executable_smoke: C03.2/C04.1 prove one pinned precompiled binding with synchronous startup/call plus failure vectors (missing/corrupt/wrong-ABI module fails visibly), independent of work package graph and all arithmetic/validation implementations.
smoke_and_pinning_scope.pins_record: Toolchain, crates, locks, protocol version, and binding route choices are recorded in pins.json with reproducible evidence or a bounded alternative; no latest-version example is accepted without actual build evidence.
smoke_and_pinning_scope.timebox: The minimal proof is timeboxed; common proof does not require full semantic modules.

text.enumeration: JS enumeration ordering is preserved for keys, including integer-like-key ordering rules and own __proto__ as data (never as prototype).
text.lossless_utf16: Text and keys cross as lossless UTF-16 code units. Lone surrogates (keys and text), controls, and own __proto__ data are preserved exactly; ordinary conversion to Rust String (which can replace unpaired surrogates) is forbidden on the compat path — use code-unit operations or an explicitly proved lossless route.

title: Freeze minimal versioned transport and profile handoffs
transport_exclusions: Can's opaque json codec rejects every number: it is unsuitable as a generic request transport and must never be used as one.
Host JSON parsing stays initially to preserve syntax diagnostics and number parsing; malformed JSON remains a host parse error at the host stage.
Number-free opaque blobs are never a substitute for scalar-carrying transport.

versioning.base_version: Transport v0 (this contract): ordered tagged nodes + explicit presence + profile ids + request tokens + result/error envelopes. Any incompatible change (ranges, text handling, strictness, digest bytes, hash inputs) is a versioned behavior decision with declared semantics and migration fixtures — never a silent parity change.
versioning.negotiation: Peers declare transport + profile versions up front; mismatch refuses before evaluation. Single selection per request/job; no mid-call profile switching.
